items.source: Can be used natively, declaring several nested RedisListener annotations. Can also be used in conjunction with Java's support for repeatable annotations, where RedisListener can simply be declared several times on the same method, implicitly generating this container annotation.
items.translation: 可以原生使用，声明多个嵌套的RedisListener注解。也可以结合 Java 对可重复注解的支持，在同一个方法上多次声明RedisListener，从而隐式生成该容器注解。

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations.
items.translation: 此注解可作为元注解，用于创建自定义的组合注解。

items.source: Container annotation that aggregates several RedisListener annotations.
items.translation: 聚合多个RedisListener注解的容器注解。
